# Synopsis: *The Underground*

**Author**: Raymond Bayly  
**Genre**: Dystopian Sci-Fi / Cyberpunk / Military Thriller  
**Length**: ~112,717 words · 28 Chapters + Epilogue  
**Formats Available**: DOCX, Markdown  

---

## Part I: Retail Back Cover Blurb

> *“They told us that without their security, we would starve. They told us that without their medicine, we would perish. They told us that without their labor, we had no value.*
> 
> *They lied.*
> 
> *The sickness that brought our world to its knees was manufactured by the men who now rule you. The chains you wear are forged only by your belief that they are invincible.*
> 
> *They are not invincible. The Underground is no longer beneath you. We are standing with you. Take back your world.”*

***

extra.section_header: Fifty years ago, democracy died without firing a shot. Today, the resistance rises from the dark.
